source.name: OECD Global Forum on Transparency and Exchange of Information for Tax Purposes
source.scope: Jurisdiction-level peer reviews of how tax authorities provide information on request. Each jurisdiction shows its latest listed assessment and the publisher’s review history. Years identify report publication. A Phase 1 assessment covers the legal framework and carries no overall rating. Monitoring updates are separate from rated peer reviews.
source.report_dates: Exact dates and report links come from unambiguous matches to OECD Publishing’s registered DOIs in the Global Forum series. Other entries link to the edition of the official ratings table.
